Four substantial projects, two from each section of the course. Between them they cover model comparison, computational and statistical programming, and real-world data. Projects 1 and 3 use the same series and the same test set, so their results can be compared directly. Select a project to open its executive summary and detailed analysis.

Benchmarks, ARMA, ARIMA and SARIMA models for Stats SA monthly nights sold, and how the treatment of the COVID-19 break changes the results.

### [Project 2: Volatility of the rand with ARCH and GARCH](project-02/project-02-garch-zar_v4.qmd){.stretched-link}

Stylised facts of USD/ZAR returns, ARCH and GARCH models, my own GARCH(1,1) likelihood code, and a rolling Value-at-Risk backtest.
